failures_and_repairs: Initial fixture expected one edit per Undo; native direct commands were coalesced. Diagnostic confirmed exact original-byte restoration. The fixture now accepts only exact captured native history states, with Core checks covering individual and coalesced byte operations.
Save completes through the owner and ends native text typing coalescence without discarding Undo; the existing AppKit event group can still contain several directly scripted actions.

An attempted fixture repair manually ended automatic Undo event groups. AppKit reported NSInternalInconsistencyException in _prepareEventGrouping/_endTopLevelGroupings. The earlier attempt then crashed (receiver 77421, SIGSEGV) in MainActor.assumeIsolated from Help close notification while a TUINS cursor window closed. Manual group manipulation was removed. Help now observes only bound app windows and marks close state with a lock. No all-SDK executor root-cause claim.

Receiver 77669 remained idle after the consistency exception. Its live PID was sampled and PID-filtered system logs inspected; it was explicitly terminated and reaped. Diagnostic logs are build/qa/unified-byte-buffer-owned-sample-2026-10-17.txt and unified-byte-buffer-owned-system-log-2026-10-17.txt.
